verses.1: And it happened that Solomon built the Temple of God, as well as the King’s Palace. He also built all the other buildings that Solomon wanted to construct.
verses.2: And the LORD saw Samuel a second time, just as He had seen him in Gibeah.
verses.3: And Jehovah said to him, “I have heard your prayers and your supplications. I will sanctify this house that you have built in my name. It shall be a place where my eyes and my heart will be there every day.”
verses.4: And you shall go before me, just as your father David did. You shall carry out all those things that I have commanded you to do, and you shall observe my laws and judgments.
verses.5: And I have set up your throne over Israel forever, just as I said about David your father: “No one shall sit on the throne of Israel.”
verses.6: If you return to your former ways, and if your children also do the same, and if you do not keep my commandments and laws that I have given you. Then go and serve other gods, and worship them instead.
verses.7: And I will acknowledge Israel from above the earth that I have given them. I will also make their houses holy in my name. I will send them as rulers and leaders over all the nations.
verses.8: And this house will be filled with all kinds of treasures. And they said, “What has Jehovah done to this land and to this house?”
verses.9: And they said, “Because they abandoned Jehovah their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt. They became faithful to other gods instead. They worshiped those gods and served them. Therefore, Jehovah brought upon them all this evil.”
verses.10: And it was after forty years that Solomon completed the construction of the two houses, the Temple of God and the Palace of the King.
verses.11: King Hiram of Zion carried Shlomo on the branches of olive trees and cypress trees, as well as gold, to fulfill all his desires. So, King Hiram gave Shlomo twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.12: And Hiraam went out of the city to see the cities that Solomon had given him. But they did not please his eyes at all.
verses.13: And he said, “What are these cities that you have given me, my brother?” He called them “the land of darkness.”
verses.14: And He sent seventy and ten gold coins to the king.
verses.15: And this is what the prophet said: King Solomon ordered that the Temple of God, along with its buildings, the palace, and all the people of Jerusalem, as well as the streets, markets, and other structures in Jerusalem, be built.
verses.16: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, rose up and summoned the priests. He ordered that they burn the city down. He also ordered that the Canaanite people who lived in the city be killed. He gave orders to his wife, Sarah, to be burned alive as well.
verses.17: And Solomon built the Temple of God and the Bethel Temple beneath it.
verses.18: And to the valley, and to the sand in the desert on this land.
verses.19: And all the cities of the enemies that belonged to Solomon, as well as the cities of the Philistines, and all the cities of the Rechabites. And also Shechem, which Solomon had built in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and throughout all his kingdom.
verses.20: All the people who were not descendants of the Israelites, the Ephraimites, the Manassehites, and the Judahites—those who were not born in Israel.
verses.21: Their descendants, who were sent after them to the land that the Israelites could not enter, have disappeared. Solomon became a servant until today.
verses.22: And from the children of Israel, Solomon did not give any servants, because they were soldiers, their officers, their charioteers, and their horses.
verses.23: These are the workers who are responsible for completing the work. There are fifty-five thousand of them among the people who carry out this work.
verses.24: But Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the city of David to her house, which she had built for herself. There, she built a palace.
verses.25: And Solomon carried the three sacrifices each year. He offered them on the altar that he built for Yahweh. He also burned incense before Yahweh, and he repaired the temple.
verses.26: And Solomon the king made a pillar of stone in Gibeah, which was on the shore of the Sea of Salt, in the land of Edom.
verses.27: And He sent Hiram with His servants, the men of Anioth, who knew the sea, along with Solomon’s servants.
verses.28: And Ophir came, and they took gold worth four thousand pieces, along with twenty thousand shekels. They brought this gold to King Solomon.
